name: PSE-Bench v3
protocol: PSE-Bench v3 fixed 200-question set, zero-shot responses, released five-judge rubric evaluator and weighted 0.15/0.15/0.20/0.50 composite. Earlier evaluator versions are excluded.

explanation.en: The overall score combines ROUGE-1, ROUGE-L, embedding similarity, and five-judge rubric-element coverage, with coverage carrying half the weight.
explanation.zh: 总分结合 ROUGE-1、ROUGE-L、embedding similarity 和五个 judge 的 rubric element coverage，其中 coverage 占一半权重。

summary.en: PSE-Bench evaluates technical completeness in open-ended chemical process modeling, optimization, machine learning, and design answers.
summary.zh: PSE-Bench 评估模型回答化工过程建模、优化、机器学习和系统设计开放题时的技术正确性与要点完整度。

task_format.en: The model gives one zero-shot open-ended answer to each of 200 process-systems engineering questions.
task_format.zh: 模型对 200 道 process-systems engineering 开放题分别给出一次 zero-shot 答案。
